findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5197). Plasma-membrane protein (UniProt Q16790: cell membrane, microvillus membrane), so antibody-accessible. TCGA tumour-vs-normal log2FC 9.712. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_3), IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_2), SULTHIAME (PHASE_4), ETHOXZOLAMIDE (WITHDRAWAL). DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.051 (no dependency), so value is as an antibody/imaging/radioligand surface target and diagnostic biomarker, not a pathway-dependency target.

Convergence rank 3 (score 4.2143). Cell-membrane ligand of CD27 (UniProt P32970). TCGA log2FC 7.09. Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB (PHASE_2), VORSETUZUMAB (PHASE_1), VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN (PHASE_1), MDX-1411 (PHASE_1). The ccRCC DepMap mean effect is 0.251 with selectivity 0.006, so there is no cell-intrinsic dependency. Rationale is an antibody/ADC/cell-therapy surface antigen, with a tumour-restricted expression pattern.

Established ccRCC drug target (HIF-2alpha). Open Targets association score 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN (APPROVAL). Tractability labels include SM Approved Drug and High-Quality Ligand. DepMap ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs other lines 0.157, selectivity 0.3, fraction of ccRCC lines dependent 0.208, not common essential. This is a selective but partial dependency (about a fifth of lines), consistent with VHL-loss heterogeneity.

Established ccRCC drug target (VEGFR2). Open Targets association score 0.4566. Approved drugs in the record include AXITINIB (APPROVAL), PAZOPANIB HYDROCHLORIDE (APPROVAL), TIVOZANIB (APPROVAL), CABOZANTINIB S-MALATE (APPROVAL), LENVATINIB MESYLATE (APPROVAL), SUNITINIB (PHASE_4), RAMUCIRUMAB (APPROVAL). Tractability: antibody (approved), small molecule (approved). It is an angiogenesis (stromal/endothelial) target, so tumour-cell DepMap dependency is not the relevant evidence.

Established ccRCC target (mTORC1). Open Targets association score 0.525. Drugs include RIDAFOROLIMUS (APPROVAL), GEDATOLISIB (PHASE_3), SAPANISERTIB (PHASE_2). DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -1.52, all ccRCC lines dependent (fraction 1.0), but common_essential is true, so there is a toxicity risk and no tumour selectivity (selectivity 0.354 only).

Association-only driver. Open Targets association score 0.6348 (rank 2 of top targets). Somatic recurrence in 511 tumours: 185 mutated (frequency 0.362), obs/exp 43.498, padj 4.59e-239, recurrent. A tumour-suppressor loss gives a stratification biomarker, not a directly druggable target.

Top Open Targets association (score 0.6466). Mutated in 247 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.483), padj 0.0, recurrent. Loss drives HIF-2alpha stabilisation, which is the rationale for EPAS1 inhibition. A loss-of-function founder lesion cannot itself be drugged directly.

Convergence rank 7 (score 3.9643). TCGA log2FC 4.685 (up in tumour), Cox log HR 0.301 (adverse prognosis, padj 0.00479), tumour-intrinsic. No drugs listed; tractability predicted only. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.316, so no dependency: biomarker case is stronger than target case.

Convergence rank 2 (score 4.2206). Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -4.741), favourable prognosis (Cox log HR -0.358, padj 0.000023). No drugs. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.156, no dependency. Proximal-tubule identity-loss biomarker, not a target.

Convergence rank 4 (score 4.1667). Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -6.154), favourable prognosis (Cox log HR -0.402). Drugs: PROBENECID (PHASE_4), PRATOSARTAN (PHASE_3), which are transporter substrates/inhibitors and not anticancer. Loss-of-expression biomarker (renal organic anion transporter); DepMap ccRCC mean effect -0.019, no dependency.

Convergence rank 5 (score 4.1052). Up in tumour (TCGA log2FC 3.989), Open Targets association 0.4049 (genetic component 0.519). No drugs listed; tractability predicted. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.002 (no dependency), so this is an untested membrane-lipid-uptake candidate without dependency support.

Convergence rank 6 (score 4.0695). Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -3.721). Open Targets association 0.4532 (genetic component 0.7338). No drugs; DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.143, no dependency. Association-driven biomarker candidate.

caveats: Only the top 12 convergence rows were read in full (output size limits), so genes ranked 13-40 were not assessed.
DepMap CD70 record has evidence_id null; its dependency values are quoted in the CD70 finding but not citable.
mutation_recurrence was run only for PBRM1 and VHL; CA9, CD70, EPAS1, MTOR and other candidates have low mutation frequency or were not tested (CA9 mutation_freq 0.002 in the ranking row).
STRING interactions and uniprot for most biomarker genes were not queried to stay within budget.
Drug lists are as returned by Open Targets and include non-oncology indications; max_stage is not ccRCC-specific.
DepMap dependency is cell-line based and does not capture stromal (KDR) or immune-directed (CD70, CA9 antibody) mechanisms.
